propositions: The deprecated env var REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be removed from the resolver and all resolver references; it was scheduled for removal in v1.0.0 and the operator approved early removal as breaking pass #3 on 2026-08-12.

A still-set REBAR_LLM_MODEL env var must fail loud with RemovedInputError during LLMConfig.from_env initialization, not silently default, because ignoring it would quietly change model selection and incur costs.
The config key [tool.rebar.llm].model must persist; it is load-bearing in rebar.toml to pin the provider and prevent inference leakage, and the deprecation registry row is env-only.
Model resolution after removal must follow CLI override > [tool.rebar.llm].model config table > DEFAULT_MODEL, with no env channel, via _llm_str taking env_name=None.
All 15 test files referencing REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be retargeted to non-env channels: config table, per-class env vars, or CLI override; setting the removed env must raise RemovedInputError.
Documentation and operator-facing material (docs/config.md, infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md, infra/compose/docker-compose.yml) must be updated from 'deprecated' to 'removed'.
